name: 3D-Fuel
summary: US filament extruder based in Fargo, North Dakota, operating since 2014 out of the Fargo 3D Printing / Filament Innovations family of businesses. Notable for a genuinely domestic supply chain — NatureWorks Ingeo PLA resin from Blair, Nebraska, spools injection-moulded domestically from recycled plastic, US-sourced packaging and labels. Acquired by Nexa3D on 12 March 2024 and now part of Nexa3D's materials portfolio, so brand direction may shift under the new parent.

oem_relationships.notes: Acquired 3D-Fuel on 12 March 2024 (Nexa3D CEO Avi Reichental), adding it to a materials portfolio that already included Essentium. Reported by VoxelMatters; not a white-label relationship — 3D-Fuel continues to extrude under its own brand.
Historic operating entity; 3D-Fuel grew out of the Filament Innovations / Fargo 3D Printing group before the Nexa3D acquisition. Current legal structure post-acquisition was not verified.

product_lines.name: ReFuel Recycled PLA+
product_lines.notes: Recycled-content PLA+ sold at a discount ($14.98-$19.90); recycled feedstock is a sourcing attribute, not a separate chemistry.

product_lines.name: Pro PCTG
product_lines.notes: Glycol-modified copolyester (PCTG); 1 kg, 4 kg and 25 lb/11 kg formats plus 50 g sample coils.

product_lines.name: Pro PCTG-CF
product_lines.notes: Carbon-fibre-filled PCTG. The catalog has no pctg-cf id, so only the base chemistry pctg is asserted — see gaps.

product_lines.name: Pro PCTG-GF
product_lines.notes: Glass-fibre-filled PCTG. The catalog has no pctg-gf id, so only the base chemistry pctg is asserted — see gaps.

product_lines.name: 3D-Clean
product_lines.notes: Nozzle cleaning / purging filament. Not a printable structural material and the catalog has no cleaning-filament id, so no mapping is asserted.

additional_notes: HQ and plant: 2222 7th Ave N, Fargo, ND 58102. Roughly 172 SKUs across 1 kg, 4/4.5 kg and 25 lb/11 kg bulk spools plus 50 g Pro PCTG samples. Pricing sits mid-to-premium ($25.95-$32.95/kg) with the recycled ReFuel line as the value tier, so price_tier premium is the closest single bucket. Legacy line names cited elsewhere in the community (Buzzed, Workday, Entwined, Pro-D) did not appear anywhere in current site content and are treated as discontinued or rebranded rather than active — they are deliberately excluded from product_lines. Build plates: none found, so makes_plates is left unset. CEO attribution differs between sources (John Machacek as founder-side figure, John Schneider as CEO in the Fargo INC! profile) and was not resolved.

provenance.conflicts: Post-acquisition legal entity naming (3D-Fuel vs Filament Innovations LLC vs a Nexa3D subsidiary) is not stated by any source. Historic branded lines (Buzzed, Workday, Entwined, Pro-D) appear in third-party writeups but not in current site content, so their status is unresolved.
